newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A+ rating to SK Telecom Yankee bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A+ rating to SK Telecom Yankee bond.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Thursday it had assigned an A+ rating to SK Telecom Co Ltd's $230 million Yankee bond issue due 2007.
The outlook for the rating is stable, S&P said in a statement.
The company, formally known as Korea Mobile Telecommunications Corp, is South Korea's leading wireless telecommunications operator.
S&P said the rating reflects SK Telecom's dominant position in Korea's wireless telecommunications market, its favourable operating environment and its very strong financial profile.
The company, which changed its name on March 21, benefits from a monopoly position in analog celullar sevices and a roughly 50 percent share in paging services, S&P said.
SK Telecom is expected to maintain strong revenue growth and a solid financial profile amid a stable operating environment, S&P said.
